description.en: Your memory as a folder of markdown files: AtAt writes what you do into it, and brings the relevant parts back.
description.zh-hans: 记忆就是一个 markdown 目录：AtAt 把你的交互写进去，需要时再拿回来。

description.en: Where your memories live. Keep it in iCloud Drive and your phone can write into the same folder.
description.zh-hans: 记忆存放的位置。放在 iCloud Drive 里，手机也能往同一个目录写。

description.en: Writes one note per interaction — your request, the answer and a summary of the attached context.
description.zh-hans: 每次交互写一篇笔记：你的请求、回答，以及附带 context 的概要。
